message:
The other day, as I was putting away the last of the summer decorations, I couldn’t help but chuckle. I remembered the time I was caught off guard by a surprise snowstorm while my neighbors were all cozy with their emergency kits. 

This year, I decided enough was enough! I finally made my own kit—complete with extra blankets, snacks, and a trusty flashlight. It felt good to finally be the one ready for whatever the weather had in store. 

Now, when the forecast calls for a storm, I can kick back and sip my tea, knowing I’m prepared. 

What’s your favorite tip for staying ready during storm season? ☕
